title: Analytic 3k-1 Steering Saturation, Equatorial n-Setting Thresholds, 16x CHSH Sharpening, and Exact Frame-Permanent Wigner Bounds for Multimode Gaussian Nodes
abstract: Chakrabarty (arXiv:2611.34874v1) recently established exact monogamy counts for a k-mode Gaussian node coupled to single-mode neighbors: at most nk-1 neighbors can n-setting steer or be n-setting Bell nonlocal with the node, while 2k-1 neighbors saturate Gaussian steering, simultaneous heralded Wigner negativity (Chakrabarty Theorem 5, W_{Y_j}(0) <= -1/(2*pi*(2k-1)^2)), and two-setting CHSH nonlocality (Chakrabarty Theorem 7, B_j >= 2 + 1/(8(2k-1)^2)). We resolve three open analytic and quantitative problems from that work with closed-form, machine-verified proofs. First (Theorem 1), on the one-photon filtered two-qubit subspace of a lossy two-mode squeezed vacuum, we construct an explicit 2n-matrix rank-1 dual steering witness for n-1 equally spaced equatorial Bloch axes plus sigma_z, yielding the universal critical transmission eta_eq(n) = 1/(1 + (n-1)^2 sin^2(pi/(2(n-1)))). This reproduces exact eta > 1/2 (n=2) and eta > 1/3 (n=3), proves with strictly physical squeezing lambda = tanh(r) in (0, 1) the global non-asymptotic filtered robustness bound SR_3^filt(eta) >= (3/80)(3*eta - 1)^2 for all eta in (1/3, 1] together with the full-Fock-space unfiltered bound SR_n(rho_{AB}) >= (1 - lambda^4)(W(lambda) - 1) > 0 -- thereby settling Chakrabarty's Open Question 1 by certifying 3k-1 three-setting steering saturation for ALL k >= 1 (previously computer-certified via SDPs only up to k = 50) -- and at n = 4 achieves exact rational threshold eta_eq(4) = 4/13 approx 0.3077, strictly beating Chakrabarty's regular-tetrahedron threshold (approx 0.31-0.32) and certifying ceil(13k/4) - 1 > 3k - 1 four-setting steering neighbors for EVERY k >= 1 (e.g., 3 > 2 at k = 1 and 12 > 11 at k = 4). Second (Theorem 2), swapping the setting assignment of Chakrabarty's Theorem 7 so the neighbor measures {O_pi, O_{pi/2}} (with O_pi = I - 2|0><0| an exact on/off photon-presence bucket detector) while the node measures {O_{pi +- alpha}} aligns multiphoton noise constructively with |1> and proves the exact non-asymptotic CHSH bound B(eta) >= 2 + 2(2*eta - 1)^2/(1 + 3(2*eta - 1)) for all eta in (1/2, 1], giving B_j >= 2 + 1/((2k-1)(k+1)) on the 2k-1 tight-frame network (4x at k = 1, 8x at k = 2, and exact 16x asymptotic sharpening over Chakrabarty's Theorem 7). Third (Theorem 3), we prove the exact Fock-Bargmann frame-permanent identities N_k = perm(G_k) and p_1(|Phi_k>) = perm(G_k/G_00)/perm(G_k), establish cyclotomic Galois rationality of N_k and p_1(|Phi_k>) for all k >= 1 (yielding new exact rational k = 3 values N_3 = 610/243, p_1(|Phi_3>) = 320/549, and eta_3^5 N_3 = 122/625 while reproducing Chakrabarty's k = 2 Eq. (58)), prove a general-k parity-split Wigner sharpening over Chakrabarty's Theorem 5 (20/9x at k = 2, 2.58x at k = 3), and derive the exact exponential heralding asymptote P_succ^max(k) = (3/2)(4/27)^k(1 + 1/(12k) + O(k^-2)). All 20 core algebraic and permanent theorems are formally verified in constructive Lean 4.35.0 (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, 0 custom axioms), backed by 16 AST-audited zero-float SHA-256 certificates and 56 adversarial tests.
